{{Quote|What can I do for you?|translated=1|Barlen|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Barlen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] of the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], he [[Arms dealer/Legends|sold weapons]] in the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Jiguuna]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. He operated a market stall next to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Suudaa Nem'ro]]'s [[Nem'ro's Palace|palace]] and paid some of his profits to the criminal.

==Biography==
The [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] Barlen lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war, he worked as a [[Arms dealer/Legends|weapons seller]] in [[Jiguuna]],<ref name="SWTOR" /> an [[Factory/Legends|industrial]] [[City/Legends|town]] controlled by a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] named [[Suudaa Nem'ro]].<ref name="TORcodex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Jiguuna}}</ref> Barlen sold several varieties of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] and accepted [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] as payment at his stall in Jiguuna's marketplace, which was located next to [[Nem'ro's Palace]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> As all [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] in Jiguuna were, Barlen was expected to pay some of the profits from his stall to one of Nem'ro's [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]] at the crime lord's [[Nem'ro's Palace|palace]].<ref name="CodexNem'roP">{{TORcite|type=codex|Nem'ro's palace}}</ref> The stall included a shooting practice target which was marked from use.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Personality and traits==
Barlen had [[Color/Legends|pink]] skin and gray [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Equipment==
While at the stall, he wore brown [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] and carried a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] and a blaster rifle on his back.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Barlen appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He appears as a weapons vendor on the planet Nal Hutta, the starting planet for players of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Imperial Agent]] classes. In ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', a game guide released by [[Prima Games]] alongside ''The Old Republic'', Barlen is represented on a map of Jigunna showing the location of various vendors and other characters.
